sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报《DealBook》负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访几位商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 吉尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 届时，你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在NYTimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, James Comey says he took it as a command.
sentences.zh: 今天，詹姆斯·科米说他把那句话当作了一道指令。

sentences.en: President Trump says he never even said it.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统说他根本没说过那句话。

sentences.en: The one word that an obstruction of justice case could turn on.
sentences.zh: 一个可能决定妨碍司法公正案件走向的词。

sentences.en: And the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而美国

sentences.en: military has waged cyber attacks on Iran's nuclear program and North Korea's missile systeMs.
sentences.zh: 军方曾对伊朗的核计划和朝鲜的导弹系统发动过网络攻击。

sentences.en: So why is it struggling to hack into the low-tech computers of ISIS?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么它在入侵ISIS那些低科技含量的电脑时却困难重重呢？

sentences.en: It's Monday, June 12th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月12日，星期一。

sentences.en: Let's go to the Flynn issue.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈弗林的问题。

sentences.en: When former FBI Director James Comey testified in front of the Senate Intelligence Committee last week,
sentences.zh: 上周，前联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米在参议院情报委员会作证时，

sentences.en: he clearly stated under oath that he believed President Trump had asked him to shut down an FBI investigation into his former National Security Advisor, Michael Flynn.
sentences.zh: 他在宣誓后明确表示，他认为特朗普总统曾要求他停止对前国家安全顾问迈克尔·弗林的调查。

sentences.en: And so that's why I understood him to be saying that what he wanted me to do was drop any investigation connected to Flynn's account of his conversations with the Russians.
sentences.zh: 所以我理解他的意思是，他希望我放弃任何与弗林关于其与俄罗斯人对话的陈述有关的调查。

sentences.en: That testimony reignited questions about whether the president has obstructed justice.
sentences.zh: 那次证词重新引发了关于总统是否妨碍司法公正的质疑。

sentences.en: Some of that could hinge on word choice.
sentences.zh: 其中一些可能取决于措辞的选择。

sentences.en: One word in particular.
sentences.zh: 特别是某一个词。

sentences.en: Michael, I think the word is hope.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我认为那个词是“希望”。

sentences.en: There's 28 words there that are in quotes and it says, quote, I hope, this is the president speaking, I hope you can see your way clear to letting this go, to letting Flynn go.
sentences.zh: 那里有28个字被加了引号，上面写着，引用，我希望，这是总统在说话，我希望你能设法让这件事过去，让弗林过去。

sentences.en: He is a good guy.
sentences.zh: 他是个好人。

sentences.en: I hope you can let this go.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能让这件事过去。

sentences.en: Adam Liptak, why did the word hope come up in this testimony?
sentences.zh: 亚当·利普塔克，为什么“希望”这个词会出现在这次证词中？

sentences.en: Well, there was questioning about whether anyone had ever been convicted of obstruction of justice merely because they'd hoped for an outcome.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当时有人质疑是否有人仅仅因为“希望”某种结果发生而被判妨碍司法公正罪。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Do you know of any case where a person has been charged for obstruction of justice
sentences.zh: 你知道有什么案件是某人因为妨碍司法公正而被起诉的吗？

sentences.en: or for that matter, any other criminal offense where this they said or thought they hoped for an outcome?
sentences.zh: 或者就此而言，因为说了或想了他们“希望”某种结果发生而犯下的任何其他刑事罪行？

sentences.en: I don't know well enough to answer.
sentences.zh: 我了解得不够多，无法回答。

sentences.en: And the reason I keep saying his words is I took it as a direction.
sentences.zh: 我之所以一直重复他的话，是因为我把它当作了一项指示。

sentences.en: So there's two things to say about this.
sentences.zh: 关于这一点有两件事要说。

sentences.en: One is it's perfectly possible to convey using the word I hope to a subordinate, who's maybe hoping to keep his job, that that's something you really want to have happen.
sentences.zh: 第一，完全可以通过对一个可能指望保住工作的下属使用“我希望”这个词，来传达你确实希望发生某事。

sentences.en: It may be something you're directing to have happen.
sentences.zh: 这可能就是你指示要发生的事情。

sentences.en: And as the president of the United States, with me alone saying, I hope this, I took it as this is what he wants me to do.
sentences.zh: 作为美国总统，当只有我一个人在场时，他说“我希望这样”，我把它理解为这是他希望我做的事。

sentences.en: Now, I didn't obey that, but that's the way I took it.
sentences.zh: 虽然我没有照做，但我当时就是这么理解的。

sentences.en: You may have taken it as a direction, but that's not what he said.
sentences.zh: 你可能把它当作了指示，但那并不是他说的。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He said, I hope.
sentences.zh: 他说的是“我希望”。

sentences.en: Those are exact words.
sentences.zh: 那是原话。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You don't know of anyone that's ever been charged for hoping something.
sentences.zh: 你不知道有谁因为“希望”某事而被起诉过。

sentences.en: Is that a fair statement?
sentences.zh: 这样说公平吗？

sentences.en: I don't as I sit here.
sentences.zh: 我坐在这里时想不起来。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. Chairman.
sentences.zh: 谢谢主席先生。

sentences.en: And the second thing to say about it is it's just not so.
sentences.zh: 关于这件事的第二点是，事实并非如此。

sentences.en: There have been prosecutions involving statements phrased in terms of hope that have led people to be convicted or serve longer sentences for obstruction of justice.
sentences.zh: 确实有过涉及以“希望”措辞表达的陈述的起诉，导致人们被定罪或因妨碍司法公正而被判处更长的刑期。

sentences.en: So the entire premise of the discussion was wrong.
sentences.zh: 所以整个讨论的前提是错误的。

sentences.en: And what were those cases where the word hope was used to prove obstruction of justice?
sentences.zh: 那么，有哪些案件是使用“希望”一词来证明妨碍司法公正的呢？

sentences.en: So there was a case of a bank robber who had a girlfriend confederate who it looked like the prosecution was going to flip.
sentences.zh: 有一个银行劫匪的案子，他有一个同伙女友，看起来检方打算让她转为污点证人。

sentences.en: And it mattered in the bank robbery whether the bank robber was carrying a knife, carrying a weapon, because that subjects him to an enhanced sentence.
sentences.zh: 在银行抢劫案中，劫匪是否携带了刀具或武器很重要，因为这会让他面临加重刑罚。

sentences.en: And he says to the girlfriend, I hope and pray you don't tell them about any weapon.
sentences.zh: 于是他对女友说：“我祈祷你不要告诉他们关于任何武器的事。”

sentences.en: That would be very bad.
sentences.zh: 那会非常糟糕。

sentences.en: And that was thought to be enough to enhance the sentence, to increase the sentence for obstruction of justice.
sentences.zh: 这被认为足以加重刑罚，增加妨碍司法公正的量刑。

sentences.en: And that sounds right to me.
sentences.zh: 这听起来很有道理。

sentences.en: But it's a good illustration of why the words don't cure the problem.
sentences.zh: 但这很好地说明了为什么这些词并不能解决问题。

sentences.en: And of course, you want to put it in the complete context of the body language and the tone of voice and the circumstances.
sentences.zh: 当然，你需要把它放在肢体语言、语调和具体环境的完整背景中来看。

sentences.en: So does it help him a tiny bit that he didn't say it in so many words, but couched it a little bit?
sentences.zh: 那么，他没有明说，而是稍微委婉了一点，这对他有一点帮助吗？

sentences.en: It helps him a tiny bit.
sentences.zh: 有一点帮助。

sentences.en: I used to be a libel lawyer and sometimes people would say, you can't sue me for libel because I said, in my opinion, so-and-so is a child molester.
sentences.zh: 我以前做过诽谤律师，有时人们会说，你不能起诉我诽谤，因为我说的是“在我看来，某某是猥亵儿童者”。

sentences.en: And the courts say, there's no magic words.
sentences.zh: 而法院会说，没有所谓的“魔法词汇”。

sentences.en: You can't sort of add three words to the beginning of a sentence and get rid of the whole case.
sentences.zh: 你不能在句首加三个词就想摆脱整个案件。

sentences.en: I can't decide if that's a comfort or not.
sentences.zh: 我无法判断这算不算是一种安慰。

sentences.en: Adam, how much of this comes down to interpretation of this single word hope?
sentences.zh: 亚当，这件事在多大程度上归结为对“希望”这一个词的解读？

sentences.en: James Comey said that the context and the president's words and his position and authority led him to think the president wanted him to drop the investigation.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·科米说，背景、总统的话语以及他的地位和权威，让他认为总统希望他放弃调查。

sentences.en: I think quite a lot of it hinges on what you understand hope to mean in the circumstances.
sentences.zh: 我认为很大程度上取决于你在那种情况下如何理解“希望”的含义。

sentences.en: And as you perceived it, while it was a request that you hoped you did away with it, you perceived
sentences.zh: 正如你所感知到的，虽然这只是一个你希望他能放弃的请求，但你感知到

sentences.en: it as an order, given his position, the setting and the like and some of the circumstances.
sentences.zh: 它是一道命令，考虑到他的地位、环境以及其他一些情况。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And proving obstruction of justice does require that the person intended to, corruptly intended to interfere with the legal proceeding.
sentences.zh: 而证明妨碍司法公正确实要求当事人有腐败的意图，即恶意干扰法律程序。

sentences.en: And if a jury were to believe that President Trump, in this setting, one-on-one with his FBI director,
sentences.zh: 如果陪审团相信特朗普总统在那种环境下，与他的联邦调查局局长一对一交谈时，

sentences.en: was just musing about what would be a happy state of the world if the investigation was to go away, that's one interpretation.
sentences.zh: 只是在沉思如果调查消失会是多么美好的世界，那是一种解读。

sentences.en: Another is that in that setting, you're probably saying it with some purpose.
sentences.zh: 另一种解读是，在那种环境下，你说话很可能是有目的的。

sentences.en: When a president of the United States in the Oval Office says something like, I hope or I suggest or would you, do you take that as a directive?
sentences.zh: 当美国总统在椭圆形办公室说出类似“我希望”或“我建议”或“你能不能”这样的话时，你会把它当作指令吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It rings in my ear as kind of, well, no one rid me of this meddlesome prieSt.
sentences.zh: 它听起来就像是，“谁能帮我除掉这个麻烦的教士”。

sentences.en: I was just going to quote that in 1170, December 29, Henry II said, who will rid me of this meddlesome priest?
sentences.zh: 我正要引用那个典故，1170年12月29日，亨利二世说：“谁能帮我除掉这个麻烦的教士？”

sentences.en: And then the next day he was killed.
sentences.zh: 然后第二天他就被杀了。

sentences.en: But I also think it's one element of a sequence of events that if you believe Mr. Comey's version is fairly damning.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这也是一系列事件中的一个环节，如果你相信科米先生的版本，这相当具有破坏性。

sentences.en: I mean, there are questions about whether you can indict and prosecute a sitting president.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，关于能否起诉和审判一位在任总统存在争议。

sentences.en: But if this were anyone else and Comey's account is correct, the elements of obstruction of justice seem pretty closely met.
sentences.zh: 但如果换作别人，且科米的陈述属实，那么妨碍司法公正的要素似乎已经非常吻合了。

sentences.en: And walk me through why you think that is.
sentences.zh: 请给我讲讲你为什么这么认为。

sentences.en: So, again, I'm going to take Mr. Comey's version of events, his word for it.
sentences.zh: 好的，我再次重申，我采用科米先生对事件的描述，以他的话为准。

sentences.en: But he said the president asked for his loyalty in the context of a discussion about whether he would keep his job.
sentences.zh: 但他表示，总统是在讨论他是否能保住工作的情况下要求他效忠的。

sentences.en: He said he hoped that the inquiry into the Flynn matter would go away.
sentences.zh: 他说他希望对弗林事件的调查能消失。

sentences.en: When it didn't, he fired the director.
sentences.zh: 当调查没有消失时，他解雇了局长。

sentences.en: And then he tweeted out, and this also, you know, could have the overtones of a threat, that Mr. Comey, he sure better hope there are no tapes.
sentences.zh: 然后他在推特上发文，这也有可能带有威胁的意味，说科米先生最好希望没有录音带。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I've seen the tweet about tapes.
sentences.zh: 我看到了关于录音带的那条推文。

sentences.en: Lordy, I hope there are tapes.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我希望有录音带。

sentences.en: Now, all of that taken together might well be enough to satisfy these criminal statutes that are written in quite abstract terMs.
sentences.zh: 现在，把所有这些放在一起，很可能足以满足这些以相当抽象术语编写的刑事法规。

sentences.en: They say you can't corruptly obstruct, influence, or impede any official proceeding.
sentences.zh: 它们规定你不能腐败地妨碍、影响或阻挠任何官方程序。

sentences.en: Would it convince a jury?
sentences.zh: 这能说服陪审团吗？

sentences.en: Maybe, maybe not.
sentences.zh: 也许能，也许不能。

sentences.en: Is it enough to go to a jury?
sentences.zh: 这足以提交给陪审团吗？

sentences.en: Most criminal lawyers might say yes.
sentences.zh: 大多数刑事律师可能会说可以。

sentences.en: And let's just step back for a second.
sentences.zh: 让我们退一步想一想。

sentences.en: Have other presidents been charged with obstruction of justice?
sentences.zh: 其他总统曾被指控妨碍司法公正吗？

sentences.en: The two most recent impeachment proceedings, or in Nixon's case, a run-up to them, both involved obstruction of justice.
sentences.zh: 最近的两次弹劾程序，或者在尼克松的案例中，弹劾的前奏，都涉及妨碍司法公正。

sentences.en: And neither one was terribly different from what we're talking about here.
sentences.zh: 而且这两者与我们现在讨论的情况并没有太大区别。

sentences.en: Nixon was accused of having the CIA tell the FBI to stand down on a Watergate investigation.
sentences.zh: 尼克松被指控让中央情报局告诉联邦调查局停止对水门事件的调查。

sentences.en: And that tracks fairly closely the kind of talk we're seeing now.
sentences.zh: 这与我们现在看到的言论非常相似。

sentences.en: You know, leaning on the government to stop an investigation was thought by members of the
sentences.zh: 你知道，向政府施压以停止调查，被司法委员会成员认为可能构成可弹劾的罪行。

sentences.en: Judiciary Committee to potentially amount to an impeachable offense.
sentences.zh: 而比尔·克林顿在被弹劾时，针对他的指控是伪证罪，以及在民事案件和陪审团调查中诱导他人撒谎。

sentences.en: And Bill Clinton, when he was impeached, the counts against him were perjury and also inducing others to lie in a civil case and grand jury investigation.
sentences.zh: 所以在这里，你又看到了在弹劾背景下围绕着同样的妨碍司法公正概念。

sentences.en: So there again, you have the same kinds of obstruction of justice concepts floating around in the impeachment context.
sentences.zh: 在那些案件中，有没有哪个特定的词像我们现在解析特朗普总统的“希望”一词那样被如此深入地剖析？

sentences.en: In those cases, were there any specific words that were parsed as intensely as we're now parsing the word hope from President Trump?
sentences.zh: 我似乎记得克林顿关于“是”这个词的含义的证词，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: I seem to remember Clinton testimony about the meaning of what the word is, is, and things like that.
sentences.zh: 这取决于“是”这个词的含义是什么。

sentences.en: It depends upon what the meaning of the word is.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 如果“是”意味着“是”且从来都是，那是一回事。

sentences.en: If is means is and never has been, that is not, that's one thing.
sentences.zh: 如果它意味着“没有”，那是一个完全真实的陈述。

sentences.en: If it means there is none, that was a completely true statement.
sentences.zh: 当你卷起袖子深入研究这些细节时，人们会极其严苛地推敲语言。

sentences.en: As you roll up your sleeves and you get into the particulars of this stuff, people will bear down on language to an extraordinary degree.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，“希望”一词现在受到的关注可能仅仅是个开始。

sentences.en: And, you know, the attention hope is getting now may just be the beginning.
sentences.zh: 亚当，如果我知道的话，是否已经有针对总统的妨碍司法公正案件在建立？

sentences.en: Adam, is there already an obstruction of justice case being built against the president, if you know?
sentences.zh: 哦，我当然不知道。

sentences.en: Oh, I certainly don't know.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，有两种回答方式。

sentences.en: And there's two ways to answer that, Michael.
sentences.zh: 特别检察官会调查这个问题吗？

sentences.en: So is the special prosecutor going to look at this question?
sentences.zh: 很有可能。

sentences.en: Very likely.
sentences.zh: 鉴于在任总统不能被起诉的普遍共识，特别检察官会对此采取行动吗？

sentences.en: Is the special prosecutor going to do anything about it in light of the general consensus that a sitting president cannot be indicted?
sentences.zh: 其他特别检察官曾退缩过。

sentences.en: Other special prosecutors have stepped back.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们研究了这个问题，并决定如果要做点什么，正确的途径是弹劾，而不是刑事起诉。

sentences.en: You know, they've looked at the question and they've decided that if something was to be done about it, the correct route is impeachment, not criminal prosecution.
sentences.zh: 所以肯·斯塔尔没有起诉比尔·克林顿。

sentences.en: So Ken Starr didn't indict Bill Clinton.
sentences.zh: 里昂·贾沃斯基没有起诉理查德·尼克松。

sentences.en: Leon Jaworski didn't indict Richard Nixon.
sentences.zh: 而前局长穆勒聘请了非常优秀的律师，全国最顶尖的律师来研究这个问题。

sentences.en: And former director Mueller has hired very good lawyers, some of the best lawyers in the country to look at this question.
sentences.zh: 但听着，现在还很早。

sentences.en: But listen, it's very early.
sentences.zh: 穆勒刚接手这份工作，还处于非常早期的阶段。

sentences.en: Mueller just got the job since very early days.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
